main.description: Assert an ad creative / placement observed in the wild into the kotoba Datom log (:adcreative/*) — the substrate for "which org is broadcasting which message", linked to the disclosed advertiser and the network that served it. Creative media blobs (screenshots of scam ads, deepfake evidence) go to DataLad → IPFS under 80-data/ad-supply-chain, NEVER git-lfs (G8); mediaCid carries the KotobaCid. Media containing a natural person's likeness (e.g. a deepfake-endorsement victim) is an ENCRYPTED-envelope CID and the person is excluded from the public graph (G9).

advertiser.description: :adtech/id of the paying advertiser, as disclosed ("paid for by" / brand) — corporate only, never a person (G9)

headline.description: :adcreative/headline — the ad's public headline / primary copy (as-published)

landingDomain.description: :adcreative/landing-domain — the click-through landing domain (joins :domain/id in passive-dns)

mediaCid.description: :adcreative/media-cid — KotobaCid of the creative media blob (DataLad→IPFS; encrypted envelope if it contains a person's likeness, G9)

lang.description: :adcreative/lang — BCP-47 language tag of the copy

servedVia.description: :adcreative/served-via — :adtech/id of the network/exchange/SSP that served it, if observable from the supply-chain object / seller chain

lastSeen.description: :adcreative/last-seen — most-recent observation; Datomic as-of: a withdrawn creative is superseded, not deleted (非終末論)

sourcing.description: sukashi G5; a creative observed once is typically :representative
